name: A2A 1.0 Server: Agent Card
description: Direct stock-Connectors A2A 1.0 endpoint for a non-production blueprint. Requires stock Connectors and Camunda engine 8.9 or later; only combinations documented in the setup guide are verified.

properties.label: Webhook ID
properties.description: Clients read the card from {connectors base}/inbound/{webhook ID}.

properties.label: Agent Card
properties.description: Describe the selected BPMN process truthfully. Keep the complete A2A_RPC_URL secret, API-key security scheme and disabled capabilities.

properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in. Details in the documentation.
